policy_presence.summary: Public official news describes school-wide AI Guiding Principles; full document not retrieved. This is a partial audit, not full policy coverage.

ai_disclosure.summary: The reported compliance-and-integrity principle calls for disclosure under applicable rules. The follow-up interview identifies substantive AI contribution to an academic outcome as a trigger for clear, prominent marking or declaration in the form required by the university, unit or instructor.

coursework.summary: Explore AI-assisted learning only within the course rules. The public news account forbids submitting copied or simply paraphrased AI output as academic work. Instructors set the permitted methods and extent; disciplinary findings and consequences remain case-specific.

exams.summary: The reviewed public sources do not establish AI permission for a particular exam. General rules address unauthorized electronic-device retrieval and cheating; Xiaoda access grants no exam permission. Obtain the applicable exam instructions before using AI.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The public guiding-principles account prohibits using sensitive, classified or unauthorized data to train or drive AI models. A campus tool listing does not authorize sensitive-data entry; current retention and tenant settings were not verified.

academic_integrity.summary: Separate research investigation (15 working days for acceptance, five working days to form the group; normally three-month investigation/six-month overall handling, with suspension/extension rules), student discipline (five-working-day defense and ten-day expulsion-hearing request), student appeals (ten-day filing, normally fifteen-day review with possible fifteen-day extension), and degree review (thirty days after acceptance). These clocks and scopes are not interchangeable.

approved_tools.summary: Xiaoda is an institutional student assistant. A dated September 2026 report states it opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025; an undated center page retains older pilot wording. Account entitlements and price were not tested. Access is separate from assessment or sensitive-data permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Xiaoda is an institutional student assistant. A dated September 2026 report states it opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025; an undated center page retains older pilot wording. Account entitlements and price were not tested. Access is separate from assessment or sensitive-data permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: The public news account recommends that instructors determine AI methods and extent from teaching objectives, explain usage rules at the start of a course and remain responsible for AI-generated teaching materials. The full guiding-principles document and specific AI-grading/upload-consent rules were not obtained.

research_guidance.summary: For graduate theses and practical achievements, the public account prohibits replacing independent academic training and AI ghostwriting, plagiarism or fabrication; supervisors provide guidance and oversight. Research-misconduct investigation and degree non-conferral/revocation have distinct authorities, response rights and review routes. SIGS rules are unit-specific.

security_procurement.summary: The guiding-principles account supplies a sensitive-data restriction; it does not establish a complete public procurement or security-approval workflow. No verified universal approval route was found in this bounded review.
